summary: @actualham for my grad #edtech classes students buy a shared hosting plan on @reclaimhosting and then we use themes that can take advantage of #IndieWeb building blocks. I figure more justified in this expense than my undergrads in an intro to #edtech class
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@actualham for my grad #edtech classes students buy a shared hosting plan on @reclaimhosting and then we use themes that can take advantage of #IndieWeb building blocks.

I figure more justified in this expense than my undergrads in an intro to #edtech class
